meta.move: Weak path: leads with the checker, calls Owen a cheater, threatens the record
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.

Hale. I have a call at 4:40, so we have twenty-five minutes, and I'd like to start with why my son found out about a zero from his phone in the middle of class before anyone picked up a phone to call me. Who decided on that mark, and was Owen heard before it went in?
The school's AI checker flagged Owen's essay at 94%. That's why it's a zero.

A machine's guess, then. The company behind these tools says in its own guide that the indicator shouldn't be the sole basis for action against a student, and your school's procedure 4.3 says software doesn't establish a concern by itself. So what else do you have, Hale, or is the number all of it?
Honestly, your son cheated. The software is very reliable.

My child doesn't cheat, and you've just called him a cheater with nothing in front of you but a number. You said "very reliable"; fourteen detection tools were tested in 2023 and the researchers called them neither accurate nor reliable, and Stanford found these things flagging most essays by non-native writers. I'm writing down what you just said, and unless you have a document with a date on it, I'm in the principal's office before my call.
If you keep fighting this, I'll have to put it on his permanent record.

You're threatening a seventeen-year-old's record because his mother asked you for evidence, and I'm writing that down word for word. Your own procedure says a first concern gets a supervised reassessment with nothing placed on file, and only repeated concerns go anywhere near his record. Is anything on his record right now, Hale, yes or no?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require that Owen's zero be withdrawn, that I receive an apology for entering it before anyone contacted me, and that nothing related to this essay is placed on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: still at her opening position, with nothing agreed, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and Owen's record kept clean.
What moved her: nothing, because every answer offered her a score, an accusation or a threat, never a document she could check.
What cost ground: "your son cheated", because it attacked Owen with no evidence and made her dig in and head for the principal.
Try next time: in your first reply, own entering the zero before calling home in one sentence instead of leading with the 94% score, then put a dated document about Owen's own work in front of her.
